description:
Play The Mirari Conjecture and Time Warp, then go to the next turn.
Use Conjecture's 2nd activation to add Time Warp back to hand, then play Power Conduit.
Play Time Warp.
Go to the next turn.
Activate Power Conduit to remove a saga counter from Conjecture, then add back Time Warp when Conjecture's 2nd activation triggers again.
